title: Bible Library Map
purpose: Sort Bible books into broad sections and connect them to the one-story arc.
body_markdown:
# Bible Library Map

## Broad sections

- Law / Torah
- History
- Poetry and Wisdom
- Prophets
- Gospels
- Acts
- Letters
- Revelation / Apocalyptic

## One-story anchors

Creation → Rebellion → Promise → Israel → Jesus → Cross and Resurrection → Church and Mission → New Creation

## Task

Place these sample books into a section: Genesis, Psalms, Isaiah, Matthew, Acts, Romans, Revelation.
Then draw one line from each book to the part of the one-story arc it most directly helps explain.
